# @mgpl-diagnostics/api

> The MGPL Diagnostics backend (Node.js ≥ 20, TypeScript): one GraphQL endpoint, `POST /graphql` (GraphQL Yoga on Fastify), for sign-in, users and roles, the test catalog, patients, bookings, samples, results and reports, billing, double-entry books, GST returns, B2B receivables, partner settlements, cash and bank, lock dates, CSV exports, and rendered report/invoice documents (base64 PDF or HTML). The kits (auth, db, catalog, report, invoice, tally, finance) are internal libraries behind a controller → service layer. PostgreSQL or MongoDB; Redis optional.

Key facts for agents:
- Layers: `src/schema` (SDL) → `src/controllers` (authorize, map) → `src/services` (kit calls) → kits. No REST routes except `GET /health`.
- Auth: `login(input: { email, password, device })` returns an access JWT (15 min, Bearer) and a single-use refresh token; `refreshSession(refreshToken, device)` rotates them; a refresh from another deviceId ends the session (DEVICE_BINDING). With TLS_FINGERPRINT_HEADER (needs TRUST_PROXY) the proxy's JA4/JA3 TLS fingerprint is stored hashed on the session and a change is audited (auth.tls_fingerprint_changed). Every request still checks the session and re-reads the user. `JWT_SECRET` required in production.
- Worker: `src/worker.ts` (`npm run worker`) runs BullMQ jobs from Redis (`src/jobs/`): password-reset emails (MAIL_WEBHOOK_URL) and documents (`startDocumentJob`, `job(id)`). Without REDIS_URL jobs run in the API process. Permissions are `resource:action`, checked per branch with `authorize(ctx, perm, branchId)`.
- Tenant isolation: orgId and actorId come from the session, never from arguments; every id is checked against the organisation.
- Errors carry `extensions.code`: UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, BAD_USER_INPUT, CONFLICT, PERIOD_LOCKED, CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, plus auth-kit codes. Unknown errors are masked.
- Money is integer paise; days are IST "YYYY-MM-DD"; the financial year is April–March. Billing needs the branch's GST stateCode; GSTR-1/3B need the organisation's GSTIN.
- Frontends use `createMgplGraphQLClient` from `@mgpl-diagnostics/client`.
- Generated files (CI-checked): schema.graphql (`npm run schema`), docs/04-api-reference.md (`npm run docs:reference`), llms-full.txt (`npm run llms`).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is, quick start
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): index of the A-to-Z docs (architecture, getting started, API reference, errors, auth, flows, documents, configuration, data and money, testing, deployment, adding a feature, client, glossary)
- [docs/04-api-reference.md](docs/04-api-reference.md): every operation with its permission
- [docs/LOCAL-AGENT-BRIEF.md](docs/LOCAL-AGENT-BRIEF.md): releases, org settings and deployment to do outside this repo
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): map and rules
- [schema.graphql](schema.graphql): the SDL
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): everything above plus the source

## Source

- [src/server.ts](src/server.ts): Fastify + Yoga, one endpoint
- [src/container.ts](src/container.ts): db, auth, job queue, services
- [src/worker.ts](src/worker.ts): the worker entry
- [src/jobs/](src/jobs/): queues, processors, mailer
- [src/graphql/](src/graphql/): context, guards, errors, scalars, loaders, schema assembly
- [src/schema/](src/schema/): SDL per module
- [src/controllers/](src/controllers/): resolvers per module
- [src/services/](src/services/): business logic on the kits
- [test/run.ts](test/run.ts): end-to-end suite
